desc:
Personalized homepage product sections show returning visitors items linked to what they browsed, while newcomers see your best sellers. Ecom Swift LLC builds the sections in your theme, sets safe fallbacks and tests both visitor types.

## Why the home page should not look the same to everyone

Your home page is a front door for very different people. One visitor is back for the third time and wants the jacket they viewed. Another has never heard of you and needs a quick sense of what you sell. A single fixed layout serves neither well.

Returning visitors often leave because finding their place again takes effort. A section that brings back what they viewed, or points to a collection they like, cuts that effort to a glance.

## What is a personalized homepage?

A personalized homepage is a home page where some sections change according to what a visitor has done on your store. Common sections include recently viewed products, items picked for you and new arrivals from a favorite collection. People with no history see a default section, such as best sellers.

## How personalization changes behavior

The goal is shorter paths. Instead of searching again, a returning shopper clicks a product they already liked. Instead of scrolling through every collection, they see new items from the one they browse most. Each shortcut removes a small reason to leave.

Personalization is also easy to get wrong. A section that shows odd items, loads slowly or ignores cookie choices harms trust. For that reason we build in fallbacks, speed checks and consent rules. Results vary with your traffic and the share of repeat visitors, which is why the top package includes click and order tracking and a test of one section.

## What a good personalized home page includes

- A recently viewed section for returning visitors.
- A best sellers fallback for people with no history.
- A picked for you section based on browsing.
- A favorite collection section showing new items from a collection they view often.
- Fallback rules for when data is thin.
- Sections that match your theme in fonts, spacing and image shape.
- Respect for cookie choices, so nothing runs without permission where it is needed.
- Fast loading, without layout jumps.
- Section order that changes by visitor type.
- Tracking for clicks and orders from each section.

## How we build it

We begin by looking at your theme, your home page and your traffic mix. We choose the sections that fit your range and decide on the rules for each one, including what happens when there is no data.

We then build or configure the sections, style them to match and connect them to your recommendation tool or your theme's own features. We test as a brand new visitor, as a returning visitor and as a visitor who declined cookies, on phone and desktop, and we check speed after the change.

Basic covers recently viewed and best sellers with a theme match. Standard adds a picked for you section, fallback rules, cookie respect and a mobile and speed check. Premium adds a favorite collection section, up to five sections, ordering by visitor type, tracking and a test of one section. You also receive notes on how to change or switch off any section.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Keep the fallback as strong as the personalized version.
- Limit the page to a few meaningful sections.
- Test with fresh and returning browser profiles.
- Check page speed after every new section.
- Explain the data use in your privacy page.

**Avoid:**
- Showing an empty section to new visitors.
- Stacking many carousels on one page.
- Loading personalization before consent where it is required.
- Hiding your main navigation behind personal content.
- Expecting precision from very little browsing data.

## Who this is for

This service suits stores with a healthy share of repeat visitors, large catalogs where browsing takes time and brands that want the home page to feel less generic. A new store with little traffic may start with the first package and grow the sections later.

## What we need from you

Tell us who your repeat visitors are and which collections matter most. We work through collaborator, staff or developer access, and a password is never needed. Share your cookie banner setup so we can respect it. You preview everything before it goes live.
